label: Remifentanil PK — Kim (2017, obesity)

extraction.tier_rationale: Total-body-weight and fat-free-mass (Janmahasatian) covariate model developed specifically to capture obesity; reference 37 y, 74.5 kg, FFM 52.3. Kernel validated to reproduce the reference individual; transcription pending human PDF confirmation.
Kim 2017 (remifentanil in obesity) scales the rapid peripheral volume on Janmahasatian (2005) fat-free mass — NOT Al-Sallami. The choice of FFM equation is the cardinal disambiguation (Trap 1).

organ_tolerance.basis: Remifentanil is cleared by nonspecific blood and tissue esterases, so its clearance is essentially independent of hepatic function — severe liver disease did not alter remifentanil pharmacokinetics.
Esterase metabolism is independent of renal function; parent remifentanil pharmacokinetics are unchanged in renal failure.
organ_tolerance.caveat: The active carboxylic-acid metabolite (GR90291) is renally eliminated and accumulates in renal impairment; the parent-drug PK this model predicts is unaffected.

extraction.tier_rationale: Remifentanil model derived to capture body-mass effects across normal-weight to morbidly-obese adults (the widest BMI envelope of the three remifentanil models). PK-only: the Kim disposition study published no effect-site link, so this model contributes to plasma comparison but not effect-site. Kernel validated to reproduce the reference individual. review_status unverified.

source_review.reviewed_by: automated source cross-check (Claude Opus 4.8 via Hypnos research agents)
source_review.method: fetched open-access reproductions, primary-paper PubMed abstracts, FDA labels, and/or the tci R package source, then numerically compared each curated typical-value parameter against the fetched values (see sources)
sources: kim-2017-remifentanil (primary Anesthesiology; paywalled, not directly read)
source_review.notes: All 6 base values (V1 4.76, V2 8.4, V3 4.0, CL 2.77, Q2 1.94, Q3 0.197), the allometric exponents (V1 0.658, CL 0.336), reference weight 74.5 kg and reference FFM 52.3 kg, and the Janmahasatian FFM confirmed CHARACTER-FOR-CHARACTER against the tci source (which cites Kim 2017, DOI 10.1097/ALN.0000000000001635). HUMAN ITEM: confirm against the primary Anesthesiology table.

notes: Kernel = remifentanil_kim_2017 (PK-only, no ke0). FFM via Janmahasatian 2005 (distinct from the Al-Sallami FFM used by Eleveld). Completes the spec's named remifentanil trio (Minto, Eleveld, Kim); its high-BMI envelope stays valid for morbidly obese patients where Minto is greyed out. Validated reference (37 y, 74.5 kg, FFM 52.3): V1=4.76, V2=8.4, V3=4, CL=2.77, Q2=1.94, Q3=0.197.
